subject: Re: Data-room: hosting regions, VPC/private control-plane, and KMS scope
messages:
From: Marta Ivanova <marta.ivanova@ferntech.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com
Cc: security@ferntech.com, oliver.chen@ferntech.com
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Data-room request: hosting region + VPC/KMS evidence

Hi Connor,

Following up on FernTech's SIG/CAIQ review — we need a short set of artifacts that confirm the following for any service endpoints FernTech would use:

- Definitive hosting regions where customer data at rest and backups can be restricted (EU-only options and whether fallbacks to other regions occur).
- For Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments: whether the control plane can be hosted in a customer VPC or if a public control plane is required; clarity on network flow (does any metadata transit Redwood-managed networks?).
- KMS behavior: can customers provide BYOK keys that never leave the customer region, or do we use a Redwood-managed key wrapping service that may cross regions? Please include key-scope/WRAP details.
- Example audit log extract showing region tags and KMS key identifiers (just stubbed entries are fine).

Could you drop these into a folder or send attachments by Dec 15? We are trying to close the SOC2 evidence bucket and need short affirmative statements for legal.

Appreciate it — Marta
Security Engineer, FernTech

Attachments: (questionnaire sections referenced: CAIQ-Storage-3, SIG-3.4, SOC2-CC6)

From: connor.obrien <connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com>
To: Marta Ivanova <marta.ivanova@ferntech.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com, neha.kapoor@redwood-inference.com, aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Data-room request: hosting region + VPC/KMS evidence

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the artifacts and a short affirmation statement for legal. High-level answers first (we'll follow with artifacts):

- Hosting regions: Redwood Hosted API offers regional tenancy and we can restrict storage to a single region (EU or US) for a given customer account. For hosted customers who choose EU-only, there is no intentional cross-region replication for primary customer data; backups and failover are configurable and we will document the default behavior in the matrix.

- Private/VPC: For Redwood Private (VPC) deployments, the control plane can be configured either in-customer (private control plane) or in a Redwood-managed control plane. If you require full network isolation, we support an on-prem/private control plane option that keeps metadata within the customer network.

- KMS: We support BYOK with customer-managed keys (CMKs) that stay in the customer's cloud KMS region. We also offer Redwood-managed key wrapping for hosted customers; those keys are region-aware but may have cross-region management metadata. The attached kms_key_scope.txt spells the details and recommended configuration for FernTech.

- Audit logs: attaching a redacted sample (infra_audit_log_sample.txt) showing region and kms_key_id tags.

Laura — can you attach the region matrix and VPC diagram? Neha — can you confirm the BYOK steps and include the exact IAM role/policy snippets? Aditya — can you add the recommended fallback policy text we should present to FernTech legal (short paragraph)?

Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood-inference.com, aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com, marta.ivanova@ferntech.com
Date: Thu, 04 Dec 2025 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Data-room request: hosting region + VPC/KMS evidence

Connor — attaching the files Marta asked for. Summary of what's attached: 

1) redwood_region_matrix.xlsx (attached) — per-customer configuration options by product (Hosted API, Dedicated, Private). Key points: Hosted EU-only = data at rest and snapshots remain in EU region; scheduled backups are regional; automated cross-region failover requires explicit opt-in.

2) vpc_network_diagram.png (attached) — shows both deployment modes: Private (customer VPC + optional private control plane in customer network) and Dedicated (Redwood-managed VPC with VPC peering options). The diagram labels the flows that traverse Redwood-managed control plane vs customer-managed control plane.

3) kms_key_scope.txt (attached) — explains BYOK flow: customer CMK stays in customer KMS, Redwood receives short-lived wrapped keys and never stores raw key material. For hosted customers who opt for Redwood-managed keys we store key metadata and key-wrapping records; actual plaintext keys are not stored. The file includes recommended KMS policies and region-tagging guidance.

4) infra_audit_log_sample.txt (attached) — redacted entries showing the event time, region:eu-west-1 tag, and kms_key_id format. Note: logs for Private deployments can be shipped to customer-controlled logging endpoints (CloudWatch/Stackdriver/S3) per the retention policy in the matrix.

Marta — if you want a single-paragraph legal-friendly affirmation, Connor and Aditya can draft that and we'll have Legal review it.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Product Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_region_matrix.xlsx; vpc_network_diagram.png; kms_key_scope.txt; infra_audit_log_sample.txt

From: Marta Ivanova <marta.ivanova@ferntech.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com, connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com
Cc: security@ferntech.com, oliver.chen@ferntech.com
Date: Tue, 09 Dec 2025 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Data-room request: hosting region + VPC/KMS evidence

Hi Laura / Connor — received, thank you. The matrix and diagrams look good at a first pass. A couple quick follow-ups before we send to Legal: 

- Can you confirm the default retention window for audit logs when shipped to customer logging buckets? (we can request longer retention on our side but want to understand defaults)
- For the BYOK flow: are key-wrapping tokens ever routed through non-EU control plane endpoints if the customer selects EU-only? We need an explicit statement that wrapped key material and key IDs remain within EU control plane if EU-only is selected.

If you can send a one-paragraph confirmation we can attach it to our SOC2 evidence folder.

Regards,
Marta

From: connor.obrien <connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com>
To: Marta Ivanova <marta.ivanova@ferntech.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com, neha.kapoor@redwood-inference.com, aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com
Date: Thu, 11 Dec 2025 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Data-room request: hosting region + VPC/KMS evidence

Marta — short confirmation statement below (attached as region_affirmation_statement.txt for your records). We're happy to have Legal provide a signed letter if FernTech requires it.

"Redwood Inference confirms that for customers who opt into EU-only hosting, primary customer data at rest, backups, and KMS-wrapped key material are retained within the selected EU region. For Redwood Private deployments, customers may deploy a private control plane inside their VPC so that metadata and control traffic remain inside customer-managed networking. Where customers choose customer-managed KMS (BYOK), key material remains in the customer's KMS and Redwood receives only wrapped tokens; we do not store plaintext key material. Default audit log retention for hosted accounts is 90 days; logs can be forwarded to customer-managed logging endpoints with customer-configurable retention."

If you want us to sign a short attestation, please let me know and I will loop in Legal.

Best,
Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: region_affirmation_statement.txt
